name: claude-saas-trading-platform
description: Multi-tenant SaaS crypto trading platform (Binance USDT-M Futures) — backend + frontend monorepo

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run db:generate --workspace=backend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
